title: 12 Best Night Markets in Chiang Mai
description: Explore Chiang Mai's vibrant night markets, from the bustling Sunday Walking Street to the authentic Chang Puak Gate. Discover street food, crafts, and unique experiences.

places.name: Sunday Walking Street (Tha Phae Gate)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Khao Soi (curry noodle soup) from a street vendor, Mango Sticky Rice, and a freshly squeezed Pomegranate juice.

places.name: Saturday Walking Street (Wua Lai Road)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grilled Sai Oua (Northern Thai sausage) and various fried snacks from local vendors.

places.name: Chiang Mai Night Bazaar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pad Thai or a BBQ skewer plate from one of the many food court vendors. Don't forget a fresh fruit smoothie.

places.name: Ploen Ruedee Night Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Gourmet burgers or tacos from a food truck, accompanied by a local craft beer. Try their fresh spring rolls too.

places.name: Chang Puak Gate Night Market (North Gate Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Khao Kha Moo (Pork Leg Rice) from the 'Cowgirl' stall, and a platter of grilled skewers (Moo Ping).

places.name: Anusarn Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grilled river prawns (Goong Pao) or a whole steamed fish with lime and chili, accompanied by a cold Chang beer.

places.name: Malin Plaza Night Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Korean Fried Chicken, various noodle dishes, and a refreshing bubble tea or fruit shake.

places.name: One Nimman Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Artisan ice cream or pastries, and creative fusion dishes from one of the many high-quality food vendors.

places.name: Warorot Market (Kad Luang)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Gaeng Hung Lay (Burmese-style pork belly curry), various types of chili dips (Nam Prik), and fresh tropical fruits.

places.name: Kad Suan Kaew Night Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Stewed pork noodles (Kuay Teow Moo Tun), crispy fried insects (if you're brave!), and traditional Thai desserts like Khanom Krok.

places.name: Thanin Market (Siriwattana Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of the pre-made curries or stir-fries with rice (choose 2-3 dishes for a full meal). Don't miss the fresh fruit and juices.

places.name: Jing Jai Market (JJ Market) - Night Zone
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly brewed coffee, organic salads, or unique baked goods from local vendors. Look for artisanal snacks.
